scope.conditions: High quality 1280x720, same 180 s input record; physical dry road for both visual presets. Capture windows start at slightly different route steps because of UI operation. 5 s active warmup plus 150 s capture, fixed resolution. The actual final page had already exercised quality/day-night changes; shader/driver caches may be warm. No cold-start or comparative speedup claim.
scope.concurrency: No numerical tests, build jobs, other benchmark or inspection render work during either capture. Screenshots and occasional browser AX observation were taken; light text/file review and this chat remained active. Not an exclusive OS benchmark.
scope.limits: Day has 3 frames >250 ms (max 359.7 ms) plus one other >50 ms; night has 3 >250 ms (max 637.6 ms). CPU spikes include scene/shadow and reflection stages; they have not been eliminated or conclusively attributed. First-use shader/driver work remains a hypothesis, not a proved root cause. All long frames are retained. Preparation itself can take tens of seconds after a cold graphics configuration change. No hardware keyboard/gamepad, audio-listening or multi-device certification.
scope.visual: day-route.png and night-route.png are actual moving browser screenshots, different route locations, not pixel-matched before/after pairs. Vehicle inspection is separately recorded.

migration.defaultStateMeaning: No default physical or controller state was added. Full historical state and collision signature must match the current contract.
migration.preserved: All existing historical parameters (including climbRateMps and manual rate limits), rigid body, wheels, gas, valves, controller state, disturbance phase, observation buffers and seed.
migration.limitation: The 3.24.0 solver is not executed. The current model recalculates the explicitly mapped initial state; this is never an exact old-model replay.

historicalMigration.observedUI: Original-model replay unavailable; explicit current-model recompute completed. Original 3.24 identity and imported source remain unchanged. Combined archives exceeded the 4 MiB persistence budget: session-only/unsaved warning preserved prior archive, and the result remained exportable.

renderPreparationAcceptance.scope: Real UI quality and day/night changes on final build, including rapid subsequent interaction while preparation was pending. Final controls resumed and no final-build JavaScript error was observed. DOM delayed-compile regression separately checks blocked scene/weather/keyboard changes and unchanged full physical state.
renderPreparationAcceptance.rejectedReason: Earlier candidate allowed material mutation during compileAsync; rapid configuration changes caused isReady TypeError and an unfinished preparation state. Its captures are not final release evidence.

vehicle.scope: Actual WebGL front-quarter studio surface PNG and separately exported independent state metadata. Separate button actions; no same-frame association claim. Independent concept reconstruction, not OEM engineering geometry.

console.scope: Final localhost:8083 source only; earlier rejected candidate logs excluded.
console.note: One retained Three/D3D11 X3595 derivative warning during ultra shader compilation. No final-build JavaScript runtime errors observed.
